CI-RS independent candidate scoped GREEN and bounded publisher source transition.

Candidate source 494e91544dd6a94967258986244248042e978e11 was fully reviewed across its six authorized paths and mechanically integrated as 6170f8c00e7406a93a9025f4290449dce8ee389f, exact tree 9d0b0ecc790e40b47ca23a116e908d8c1ebbd7bc. Independent complete internal/release run: 120 RUN / 120 PASS / 0 FAIL / 0 SKIP, 130.889 seconds, clean checkout and unchanged source/holders. The frozen 61 candidate cases returned exactly their expected 6 GREEN / 41 RED / 14 NOT_EXECUTED outcomes; all 104 candidate/consumer/pins invocations had no unhandled boundary or harness deadline. Root checked 2,757 command capture pairs, 9,469 captured files and all 34,668 author manifest bindings. Root review SHA256 0e14baca23a7cae933023ef41d8d992d96e1ece039803b3912e00d39ec850a39. Five additional foreign-source proof controls have their separate coordinate5718523007 and are not counted in this result.

The independent publisher holder e9dcab2e3e2d1bdc6c042f3278da6c3a0aa7127d was read completely and repeated through its exact shell entrypoint. The observed failure is CAPABILITY_ABSENT RunSupplyPublisher: 50 prepared cases, ZERO publisher SUT calls, not 50 semantic REDs. All 43 enumerated real fixture controls completed; root captured494 command pairs/59 HTTP pairs, all19 forge processes joined and6 owned receive-pack hook pairs verified. Author1883 binding manifest verified; frozen candidate/consumer/pins holders unchanged. Root review SHA2564b194ee643f73276744a8bd0574c542e4c1f5c1ed9bf378eee3211b1b014cc33. The three holder-only commits were mechanically imported as aggregate75ea46f4c30a945ee1cbd5e7db2b0b735c5839f4, tree67ff0475ca556e52c0da987eb27e126dd9c0421c.

Root authorizes the independent implementation worker, from this clean aggregate, for exactly scope-plan SHA2562caecc0f45d2b8e15e7c3eec0c0ea206d3279deaca6a144308d7919bbeae3ceb: new internal/release/publisher.go, publisher_tree.go, publisher_forge.go, publisher_effects.go, publisher_release.go; bounded reuse in candidate.go, pins.go, consumers.go and manifest.go. No tests, authority/schema/predicate relaxations, public CLI/P9/legacy scripts, consumer workflows/pins, protections or other source paths are authorized by this transition. Frozen holders remain unchanged.

The implementation must perform exact B plus phase predicates, immutable ready-tree/base ownership, full bound plan admission, protected PR/checks/expected-head merge, actual accepted receiving target content/ancestry, fixed pre-tag baseline and actual published archive/consumer proof. Typed branch/PR/merge/tag/note readback preserves previous effects; no automatic write retry, no dependent write after UNKNOWN, no main/force/admin bypass. Initial wrong execution key differs from actual post-admission input drift.

Compatibility applicability is explicit: only a complete tracked protobuf census EMPTY on BOTH exact baseline and target, before archive omissions, establishes that the Buf comparison has no subject. This is no general Go API/behavior compatibility claim. Deleted-last-proto, missing expected source, unreadability or nonempty either side cannot become that result. Version progression and actual corelib no-reverse PRO-Robotech requirements remain mandatory. Nonempty domains require the fixed source/tool-bound existing Buf semantics against exact target; unsupported layout/policy/tool remains NOT_EXECUTED. Historical v0 minor-on-break is not generalized to stable same-major v1+ breaking. Existing legacy checks remain intact.

Worker freezes source, runs the actual publisher holder and complete existing package regression, retaining failed attempts; independent root post-diff review/replay follows. This grants implementation only, NOT live producer D8 execution, GitHub product publication, merge/tag, consumer runtime or issue closure.
